title: tapper flight manifest
description: Schema for a tapper flight manifest edited by `tap flight edit`.

cover.description: Kegs available while the flight is active. Empty or omitted means the flight restricts nothing.

namespace.description: Namespace containing the keg. The @ sigil is optional.

keg.description: Keg name covered by this flight entry.

role.description: Maximum role granted by this cover entry. Omitted roles default to viewer.

allowedKegs.description: Legacy local-manifest cover list. Bare entries are treated as editor cover rows for backward compatibility.

instructions.description: Markdown instructions injected into orientation output while the flight is active.
